The accessor/descriptor agreement's two controls (a cook accessor pair swapped and a block pointer slot moved through go build -overlay, each required to red exactly its own fields) ride here too. The numbering walk's control (the grouped walk planted in the emitter through go test -overlay: arms_ptr and maps_pointers must red) and the float NaN control (table_widen_f32's bit surgery replaced by the hardware conversion through go test -overlay: the signalling NaNs must red) ride here too.
